description: Experiment description. The characteristic failures are a plan written as if performed, a deviation smoothed into standard practice, uncontrolled conditions presented as controlled, and a single run generalized.

rules.message: This genre records what was performed; move the plan to a separate record.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:в целом по протоколу|с небольшими отклонениями|как обычно|стандартным образом|по стандартной методике|в штатном режиме)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Name the deviation, its step, and its extent.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:при прочих равных|в одинаковых условиях|в идентичных условиях|при неизменных условиях)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: List the controlled factors and name those that were not controlled.
One run shows what happened in that run; state the number of runs.
Record the exact version at the time of the run; it will not stay current.
